text: Need to consider how the agent can use engram tooling to first ensure that a file has been loaded into the engram database.
Need to add bug logging into the agent harness for issue tracking and CE learning/loop refactor of agent harness.

Consider how to output research, bugs, and other content first to file rather than loading it directly into the context window. Then use the graph, vector, and document store to more efficiently consume the information needed, especially in subagent processes with cheaper models, to make decisions and produce outcomes.

For the agent harness, need to determine what the correct workflow should be without exception. Should the agent always decompose research into a plan, a plan into features, and features into tasks and subtasks? And should each feature be developed on a unique branch through to completion and PR/merge before starting on the next feature? If so, this should be a distinct policy applied to the agent harness composition.

Add tree-sitter parser support for Swift, Kotlin, C, and C++ to the code graph Language enum and parse dispatch. Each language needs a dedicated submodule under src/services/parsing/ following the same pattern as the Tier 1 languages shipped in 026-F. Grammar crates must stay pinned to 0.23.x (ABI 14) per the tree-sitter ABI constraint documented in docs/compound/build-errors/tree-sitter-grammar-abi-tsx-dispatch-2026-04-15.md.

Add tree-sitter parser support for SQL dialects to the code graph: T-SQL (SQL Server), PL/SQL (Oracle), PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite. Each dialect may share a common SQL grammar (tree-sitter-sql) or require dialect-specific grammars. Evaluate grammar crate availability and ABI compatibility before implementation. Extend Language enum, default_supported_languages(), and language_from_path() accordingly. Grammar crates must stay pinned to 0.23.x per the ABI constraint in docs/compound/build-errors/tree-sitter-grammar-abi-tsx-dispatch-2026-04-15.md.

Add tree-sitter parser support for Markdown to the code graph. Extend the Language enum with a Markdown variant, add a dedicated submodule under src/services/parsing/markdown.rs, and wire into language_from_path() for .md and .mdx extensions. The tree-sitter-md grammar crate should be evaluated for ABI compatibility — must stay pinned to 0.23.x (ABI 14) per the constraint in docs/compound/build-errors/tree-sitter-grammar-abi-tsx-dispatch-2026-04-15.md. Symbol extraction should target headings, code blocks, and link references as indexable nodes.
